entries.title: Your CT scan could reveal a hidden heart risk—and AI just learned how to find it
entries.description: What if your old chest scans—taken years ago for something unrelated—held a secret warning about your heart? A new AI tool called AI-CAC, developed by Mass General Brigham and the VA, can now comb through routine CT scans to detect hidden signs of heart disease before symptoms strike.
